name: kzxl/lite-platform
description: Sovereign, High-Performance, Zero-External-Dependency Full-Stack PHP 8.2+ Ecosystem (ORM, Queue, Admin, HTMX View, Inertia, API, Audit, Export, Validate, Util).

suggest.kzxl/lite-orm: Micro-ORM with DataMapper, batch eager loading, and query builder
suggest.kzxl/lite-queue: Background job queue with SQLite/MySQL atomic locking and worker daemon
suggest.kzxl/lite-admin: Instant auto-CRUD admin dashboard via entity attributes
suggest.kzxl/lite-view: OpCache Blade template engine with HTMX fragment isolation
suggest.kzxl/lite-inertia: Zero-dependency Inertia.js protocol adapter for React/Vue
suggest.kzxl/lite-api: REST API toolkit with HS256 JWT and rate limiting
suggest.kzxl/lite-export: Streaming Excel OpenXML & CSV exporter with formula injection defense
suggest.kzxl/lite-audit: Tamper-evident entity audit trail ledger and mutation timeline
suggest.kzxl/lite-util: Multilingual number-to-words currency formatters and helpers
